Create fillable form

Design real interactive fields on any PDF.

Place text fields, checkboxes and dropdowns directly on a PDF and save genuine AcroForm widgets with names, options and required flags. Then fill and flatten it in one flow.

Processed entirely in your browser. Your file is not uploaded, stored or retained by Paperly.

How Create fillable form works

  1. Open the PDF and choose a field type.
  2. Click the page to place fields; drag, resize and name them.
  3. Save the interactive PDF and test it with Fill PDF forms.

Limitations

Results depend on the input document. Always keep the original file until you have verified the output.

Related tools

  • Fill PDF forms — Complete interactive fields without printing.
  • Flatten PDF — Lock in form values and the exact visual result.
  • Sign PDF — Draw or type a signature and place it anywhere.
